text:
If you must love me, let it be only

for love of my love. Never say

that it is for my appearance, my smile, the melody

of my voice, or for my gentle character


that agrees with yours, or that on that day

made us feel happy...

For, my love, all these things

may change, and even love dies.


Do not love me either for the tears

you compassionately wipe from my face...

For I may forget to weep


thanks to you, and so lose your love!

For love of my love I want you to love me,

so that it may dwell in heaven, eternally.

translation.title: If You Must Love Me
translation.editorial_note: The translation follows the Spanish version's insistence on love grounded only in love itself.
